treaty_name: Convenzione tra il Governo della Repubblica italiana ed il Governo dello Stato del Qatar per evitare le doppie imposizioni in materia di imposte sul reddito e per prevenire l'evasione fiscale (2002, Italian text rectified by Protocol of 2007)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed: ... (b). 15% per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

(a). 5% per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which has owned directly or indirectly at least 25% per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends for a period of at least 12 months preceding the date the dividends were declared;

2. Tuttavia, tali interessi sono imponibili anche nello Stato contraente dal quale essi provengono ed in conformità alla legislazione di detto Stato, ma, se la persona che percepisce gli interessi ne è l'effettivo beneficiario, l'imposta così applicata non può eccedere il 5 per cento dell'ammontare lordo degli interessi.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according with the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Convention, a resident of a Contracting State shall not receive the benefit of any reduction in or exemption from taxes provided for in this Convention by the other Contracting State if the main purpose or one of the main purposes of the creation or existence of such resident or any person connected with such resident was to obtain the benefits under this Convention that would not otherwise be available.

notes: Valid_from per Art. 30(2)(a): 'in respect of taxes withheld at source, to amounts derived on or after 1st January of the year of the signature of this Convention' (2002) — retroactive; refund claims for the period before entry into force (2011-02-07) had to be filed within two years (Art. 30(3)). Dividend 5% tier: company other than a partnership holding >=25% directly or indirectly for at least 12 months preceding the date the dividends were declared (min_holding_days 365 approximates '12 months'). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) when the payer is the Government or a local authority, when paid to the other State's Government/local authority/wholly-owned agencies incl. financial institutions, or to agencies on loans under inter-governmental agreements — not modelled. 2007 Protocol only rectifies the Italian text (rates unchanged). Not covered by the MLI (Italy signatory, not a Party).
